fit_standard: The branch fit standard: silence-cluster-merge trims (silencedetect -45 dB, min silence 0.25 s, clusters merged across non-silent gaps < 0.35 s, 0.05 s pads); absolute starts LOCKED from the measured fitted durations + the phase-20 pause map (fitted_end + planned gap = next start by construction — no overlaps, the VOICE FIT RULE). No atempo on any line in either voice: each programme's windows derive from its own takes.
chain: Per-stem: acompressor (threshold -16 dB, ratio 3, attack 2 ms, release 120 ms) -> measured scalar toward -13.8 LUFS -> alimiter LAST (limit 0.70, level=0 — the R-8 root-cause fix carried from phase 17). Stems at the locked starts; bed (cited asset, loop-extended with 3 s crossfades to the programme length) at a single measured scalar ~13 dB under the voice mix, continuous; two-pass loudnorm master to I=-14 / TP=-1.5. Every master verified by measurement on the delivered file.

Deviation recorded here per the R-8 discipline; properties verified on the delivered files, below.
